title: Episode 04B · 2 January · Society before office → office/colleagues → Society after office
sequenceRule: A single chronological view combines existing 5 office lead scenes, 4 parallel colleague encounters, 3 after-work society scenes, and 1 grounded morning society/home callback per lead. Broad work blocks contain more focused colleague scenes and are not a contradiction.
dhikaPattern: Source-inspired structure only: incomplete earlier observation → ordinary return/errand → chosen exposure/consensual close contact → response and private after-effect; no original prose copied.
locks: Do not invent breast/nipple/navel/buttock exposure in 04A if source says no such view.
No twins on 2 January for any of these five lead tracks.
No kissing and no explicit sexual acts in 04B; all contact adult, willing and independent of official hierarchy.
No made-up Chintu guard shift on Shreya's morning. Her morning entry is at home.
No repaired car claim for Meenakshi; hospital M08 11:00–11:40 preserved.
The earlier 04A stories and previously saved society ideas remain separate archives and are NOT overwritten.
Twenty authored prose scenes are available, but twenty existing peer subplots remain plot-only for later prose.

events.continuityNote: Earlier Poonam/Verma private involvement is reader-only; Shreya does not suddenly know.

events.title: Kavita and Lokesh: an equal-rank spark
events.location: Police training store and open training area

beats.title: Practical teamwork
beats.action: Kavita asks Lokesh to help lay out the training flags and report an inaccurate count. Meera observes only a normal professional exchange and exits.

beats.title: Their own moment
beats.action: After correcting the count Kavita deliberately lingers beside Lokesh and playfully challenges him to match her speed on tomorrow's individual fitness practice. He agrees with visible enthusiasm. Both notice their mutual interest without declaring a relationship.
beats.physical: A friendly consensual shoulder-side pose for checking a duty sheet; no kiss or sexualized training exercise.
beats.psychological: Kavita's independent attraction is tentative, unrelated to Shreya's authority.

events.continuityNote: Both are adults in training roles; no invented voyeur audience.

events.title: A voluntary after-duty charm exercise is proposed

beats.title: Not official police training
beats.action: During an ordinary break Shreya proposes an informal after-duty acting exercise called 'Seduce Him' to four adult colleagues. It is an optional theatrical flirting challenge, not a police instruction or evaluation; no one is assigned a task, including the chai helper.

beats.title: Consent and roles
beats.action: Kavita, Meera, Poonam, Anjali and the station tea helper may opt out with no consequences. He is told the premise before any teasing starts, and nobody uses uniform, badge or authority to pressure him.

events.title: Shreya and Lokesh: composure instead of bravado

beats.title: Professional basis
beats.action: Shreya signs the five-person training outcome and asks Lokesh for a concise, honest critique of the drill as an instructor.

beats.title: Quietly direct response
beats.action: Lokesh says her calm gaze during the drill made him pay closer attention than a shouted instruction would. She replies with dry humour but notices that, unlike Rohas, Lokesh leaves the personal implication for her to interpret.
beats.physical: No direct body touch; no office Chotu overlap.
beats.psychological: Her private response is distinct from the later after-duty chai-helper scene.

events.continuityNote: Shreya remains the senior officer; there is no duty-for-intimacy exchange.

events.title: Seduce Him — a voluntary acting challenge
events.location: After-duty staff tea corner, publicly accessible exit nearby

beats.title: A playful proposition, not a command
beats.action: At the end of duty, Shreya suggests a short acting-game experiment among willing adults. Each volunteer tries a different style of flirtatious conversation with the chai helper, who explicitly accepts the game but is free to stop.
beats.limits: No official training credit, compelled participation, grade, touching, or humiliation.

beats.title: Kavita — bold humor
beats.action: Kavita tries a mischievous, witty compliment. The tea helper replies with a dry observation and continues pouring tea, unfazed.
beats.reaction: Kavita laughs; no romantic success or coerced attraction.

beats.title: Meera — gentle sincerity
beats.action: Meera tests a quiet, gracious tone and thanks him for remembering everyone's order. He smiles warmly but treats her as a valued colleague, not a flirtation invitation.
beats.reaction: She accepts his kindness without treating it as a failed person.

beats.title: Poonam — direct confidence
beats.action: Poonam delivers one direct personal compliment and holds eye contact. He answers politely but keeps the conversation ordinary.
beats.reaction: Poonam leaves amused rather than embarrassed; prior ACP Verma dynamic is not disclosed.

beats.title: Anjali — clever banter
beats.action: Anjali's administrative wit turns the encounter into an exchange about who reads people better. He returns an equally clever line, keeping his composure.
beats.reaction: No one forces him to choose a winner; the four approaches differ.

beats.title: Shreya notices an untouched question
beats.action: Seeing the four voluntary attempts not unsettle him, Shreya remembers the Jan1 accidental torn-uniform moment with SOCIETY Chintu—not a scene witnessed by this STATION chai helper. She wonders whether the difference is self-presentation rather than a script.
beats.continuity: No invented photo, CCTV clip or shared knowledge of Jan1 Chintu accident.

events.title: Shreya's private, willing upper-back gesture
events.location: Staff-side refreshment alcove near station exit; female coworkers remain elsewhere

beats.title: A new private invitation
beats.action: With the other four women outside the alcove, Shreya is already changed into a sleeveless civilian top and trousers. She privately asks Chotu if he is comfortable helping apply a small amount of her own muscle-relief balm to the upper shoulder-blade area after the previous day's physical training. He may refuse freely and is not acting under an officer's order.
beats.bodyParts: Exposed shoulders and upper back, civilian outfit
beats.limits: She remains clothed and appropriately covered; no patient, trainee or child is present.

beats.title: A defined, welcomed contact
beats.action: Only after he agrees, Shreya turns away and moves her hair aside. He applies the balm briefly to her upper back; she checks his response through a short question and a glance rather than a camera or a witness.
beats.reaction: He remains careful and attentive; one momentary personal pause is visible but not a declaration of desire.

beats.title: Heat without forced escalation
beats.action: Shreya notices an involuntary wave of warmth, quickened breathing and self-conscious excitement, surprising herself because she intentionally invited the encounter. She thanks him, repositions her outer layer and leaves. The interaction ends there.
beats.psychological: Compared with the group challenge, she values the fact that she made a personal choice instead of giving an instruction.
beats.limits: No kissing, explicit exposure, genital/breast touching or new promise.

events.title: Station exit, family checkpoint and repaired shirt remembered

beats.title: Post-shift time without teleporting
beats.action: Shreya leaves the station about 18:35 following the separately voluntary station Chotu scene, travels to Gulmohar Heights and checks that Anaya is being cared for by family in a separate space. The identity and exact Jan2 movements of the caregiver, Vikram and Arvind remain unresolved; the adult encounter is held away from Anaya.

beats.title: The shirt is genuinely damaged
beats.action: She remembers the Jan1 corridor latch mishap: two upper buttons were deliberately loosened and two adjacent lower buttons broke. The source never established exactly what Chintu saw. The shirt has been retained, not casually treated as if those missing buttons still worked.

beats.title: Spare buttons and a non-work invitation
beats.action: Shreya has two spare replacement buttons sewn into the damaged shirt before this encounter, keeping that repair offstage rather than inventing how Chintu could fasten missing buttons. Chintu returns separately about the latch status, after his service duty; she asks whether he would be willing to help check the new buttons as a personal favour. He is free to say no.

events.title: The broken uniform: she chooses a second view
events.location: Shreya apartment entry dressing nook, away from family rooms

beats.title: The old uniform returns on purpose
beats.action: Shreya has deliberately put the very same repaired khaki uniform shirt over an opaque, secure camisole and trousers; the garment carries an unmistakable connection to yesterday's latch incident. A towel is loosely draped at the waist for her forthcoming change, but her body remains fully covered.
beats.bodyParts: Uniform neckline, shoulders; opaque camisole and trousers below
beats.continuity: No torn fabric from a fresh accident; spare buttons were sewn in beforehand.

beats.title: She requests buttoning and checks whether he remembers
beats.action: She asks Chintu if he can check whether the repaired front buttons close correctly. If he freely agrees, he fastens the two replacement buttons by their placket while she holds the shirt steady, carefully keeping his touch on fabric rather than her body. She lightly teases him about looking so alarmed the day before.
beats.reaction: Chintu checks the repair and answers with surprised, respectful humor; neither can know what was seen yesterday beyond their own POV.

beats.title: She decides to undo what was just fastened
beats.action: Instead of a second accident, Shreya chooses to release the repaired buttons herself, slips the outer khaki shirt off her shoulders and keeps the opaque camisole and trousers/towel securely in place. She faces Chintu and intentionally asks whether he now understands that yesterday was an accident and tonight is her own choice to appear differently.
beats.bodyParts: Exposed shoulders and upper back; fully covered chest and lower body
beats.actionName: Voluntary outer-shirt removal and upper-back reveal over opaque layer
beats.sightline: Adult-only apartment entry nook, no child, elder, CCTV recording or public spectator.

beats.title: The encounter actually changes her
beats.action: Chintu is momentarily speechless at her directness rather than claiming he saw a specific amount in the Jan1 accident; he responds with a small, gently teasing line, and she notices his gaze. Shreya experiences an unexpected warm rush, brief skin tingling and flushed self-awareness because she initiated the moment, then restores her shirt and ends the exchange.
beats.psychological: Her desired escalation is a personally chosen reversal of the earlier embarrassment, not unconsented nudity or compulsory contact.
beats.limits: No kissing, explicit breast/genital exposure, coercive job pressure, photographs, or voyeurism.

events.title: After Chintu leaves: warmth and the household return

beats.title: Family is real, not a disappearance
beats.action: Chintu leaves, Shreya dresses privately and checks on Anaya. Her husband Vikram's Jan2 schedule and other relatives' locations are not invented; Shreya's internal warm/tingling after-effect remains private and non-graphic. Twins absent.

leads.notes: Morning is placed BEFORE office only when grounded; Shreya has a home continuity check, not an invented morning Chintu duty encounter.

leads.name: Meenakshi

events.title: The car that hasn't come home

beats.title: The broken car is still broken
beats.action: At 07:40 Meenakshi checks with Babloo about the car stalled near the badminton court. No mechanic has yet verified the repair, recovery or final cost.

beats.title: The earlier uncertainty is about his voice, not nudity
beats.action: Their confirmed Jan1 Babloo encounter occurred in EP03: he gave a surprisingly direct compliment on her ordinary plum-kurta look and offered recovery help. There was NO 04A body-exposure or contact incident.

beats.title: Family and hospital clock
beats.action: Meenakshi checks Vihaan's ordinary family care, tells Babloo not to move the vehicle without permission, books a cab instead of inventing a usable car, and reaches duty before 09:10. The user-shifted M08 stays 11:00–11:40.

events.origin: Original 04A or Episode03 callback, newly planned Jan2 micro-encounter

events.title: Clinical work, quiet memory without invented accident

beats.title: Doctor's duty first
beats.action: Meenakshi focuses on actual patient and ward responsibilities after an emotionally active Jan1. No twins at the hospital or in an after-work society visit.

beats.title: Known colleague, unresolved Jan1 Naveen handoff
beats.action: Naveen is an established hospital assistant. January 1 14:15 interaction remains an unresolved earlier cutpoint; neither an accident nor any hidden intimacy from it is invented.

events.title: Meenakshi and Yash: after yesterday's startling closeness

beats.title: Work first
beats.action: Yash flags a mismatch in the morning clinical-camp statistics. Meenakshi listens, gives a precise correction, and signs off only after he verifies the figures.

beats.title: Shared memory, new direction
beats.action: When Aditi leaves with the corrected file, Yash acknowledges that yesterday's unexpectedly close car moment has stayed with him. Meenakshi says she remembers it too, but makes no claim that this gives him a new invitation.
beats.physical: No repeat abdomen touch, passenger-seat rivalry or car incident.
beats.psychological: Her maturity lets her acknowledge attraction while controlling timing and boundary.

events.continuityNote: Yesterday's F19 direct abdominal contact happened once and isn't staged again.

events.title: M08 — shifted senior review remains fixed

beats.title: Locked shifted time
beats.action: The user-shifted M08 senior review goes from 11:00 to 11:40. It is not replaced by Chotu flirting or another medically implausible scene.

events.title: Naveen's real administrative handover

beats.title: Operational reason
beats.action: Naveen hands off approved review documents and wellness records, without a falling binder, missing page or fake emergency. She notices his attentive presence while checking the document dates.

beats.title: An unresolved personal question
beats.action: Their routine conversation leaves Meenakshi wondering why she wants his attention outside the work he performs; she does not use senior clinical authority to obtain it.

events.title: Rounds, case work, discharge documents

beats.title: Work and family remain real
beats.action: Meenakshi finishes clinical duties, with Vihaan's childcare arranged offstage in ordinary family care. The abandoned Jan2 car-seat rivalry, Babloo hatch, repeated twin flirting and first-aid hand demonstration are NOT revived.

events.title: Aditi and Avi: their existing playful rapport

beats.title: Medical camp rationale
beats.action: Aditi asks Avi to correct a consent-form template before the afternoon briefing. They are peers in the programme and work at a desk away from patient rooms.

beats.title: A different peer spark
beats.action: Avi jokes that she has been harder to impress since the farmhouse evening. Aditi replies that good work and good conversation both count; he makes the correction and waits for her approval, then asks if she would join coffee when their shifts permit.
beats.physical: Mutual willingness to sit closely over a shared document, no staff/patient exposure or compulsory touching.
beats.psychological: Their prior farmhouse chemistry develops rather than being reset to first meeting.

events.continuityNote: Aditi/Avi farmhouse teasing was in Episode03 and remains separate from Yash/Meenakshi.

events.title: Meenakshi and Avi: the new question

beats.title: A justified follow-up
beats.action: Avi brings the revised camp inventory to Meenakshi for sign-off and asks why Yash handled the review so quietly today. She tells him to focus on his own evidence.

beats.title: Flirtation without repeated touch
beats.action: His teasing nearly turns the talk into yesterday's rivalry. Meenakshi stops him and says that if he wants her attention, a confident answer to the actual work question will impress her more. Avi meets her direct gaze, replies correctly, and sees that she is smiling.
beats.physical: No repeat waist/abdomen touching or intentional wardrobe slip.
beats.psychological: For Meenakshi, attention is a choice she directs, not a reward granted by seniority.

events.continuityNote: Don't repeat the farmhouse conversation or car-seat competition.

events.title: Rupa and Yash: their own quiet rapport

beats.title: Clinical handoff
beats.action: Rupa asks Yash to check a lab sample pickup list against the nurse handover. Both work within normal assigned duties with no patient contact staged.

beats.title: An independent possibility
beats.action: Yash notices that Rupa has stayed late to get the list right; Rupa replies that she values people who can be attentive without being loud. Yash smiles and offers to bring her tea during the next genuine break, and she says she might take him up on it.
beats.physical: No intimate touching, no invented couple status.
beats.psychological: Rupa's agency and independent work style are foregrounded; no automatic triangle with Meenakshi.

events.continuityNote: Rupa's first independent peer interest is a proposal, not a source-established relationship.

events.title: The sari-pallu decision
events.location: Hospital private staff changing → non-clinical administrative reception

beats.title: Independent wardrobe choice
beats.action: After clinical duty Meenakshi dresses in her own selected sari with a deep neckline, bare midriff and upper back, while preserving normal changing-room privacy. Her sari-pallu drape is deliberately chosen; it is not accidentally pulled aside.

beats.title: A personal question, outside patient care
beats.action: Meenakshi sees Naveen during final wellness paperwork at the nonclinical reception and chooses to ask if he is comfortable with a private, clearly personal moment. His reaction surprises her precisely because she intended to notice it.

beats.title: Mutually agreed waist embrace
beats.action: If Naveen freely accepts the contact, she invites a single close waist embrace; it ends as soon as she releases him. This is her deliberately chosen gesture, not a nurse demonstration, duty-related touch, or proof of later consent.
beats.limits: No kiss; no patient spectators; no senior-pressure dynamic; no explicit exposure.

events.title: Meenakshi leaves for family

beats.title: End without invented crossover
beats.action: She turns back toward Vihaan and Nikhil's household routine, privately surprised by the intentional choice she made; no Babloo society accident, twins, or work-related consequence is invented as a fact.

events.title: Hospital exit, child-care checkpoint and genuine car news

beats.title: A working mother's return
beats.action: Meenakshi leaves hospital at 18:00 and returns to the household. She checks Vihaan's family care and lactation routine. Her baby's designated carer during the workday is not invented.

beats.title: Car is still a real continuity problem
beats.action: Babloo, the already familiar society pharmacy helper, calls or messages with a status update on the stalled car from Jan1. A mechanic report/quote may be available but the vehicle is NOT assumed repaired, moved or driveable. Babloo has agreed to help with the car since the EP03 18:45–19:00 scene.

events.title: Doctor Madam sets the personal terms
events.location: Adult-only Kapoor apartment entrance / common foyer

beats.title: A new visual emphasis after the hospital scene
beats.action: After family care Meenakshi changes into a chosen, open-back evening sari/blouse, different from her hospital styling. She knowingly leaves the back design uncovered and gently moves her hair aside when Babloo arrives to discuss the repair update.
beats.bodyParts: Shoulders, upper/lower back, side waist and midriff; defined neckline
beats.actionName: Deliberate full open-back and side-waist display with hair set aside
beats.sightline: Adult-only doorway, no toddler or unrelated elder watching

beats.title: Deliberate conversation, not a car hatch or parcel accident
beats.action: Meenakshi asks whether Babloo would give his personal opinion on the chosen evening sari rather than simply handing over the mechanic status. After asking whether he welcomes the closeness, she steps beside him for one still framed pose and permits a brief light hand at her lower back—different from an office waist embrace.
beats.limits: No sex, genital/breast touching, nudity, kiss, car-hatch accident or invented repair success.

beats.title: The unsettled mature response
beats.action: Meenakshi notes that she initiated a more open personal moment for someone she used to know only as a dependable helper. Babloo responds with confident courtesy rather than repeating the EP03 first compliment verbatim.
beats.psychological: Intentional desire for his attention and relief at being able to choose the encounter, without suddenly erasing affection for Nikhil.

events.title: Household returns to the foreground

beats.title: Family track and honest unknowns
beats.action: Meenakshi returns to care for Vihaan, waits for further car news if needed, and continues the Nikhil marital track without invented late-night outcomes. Mohan, Dev and Ishita's precise Jan2 location remains unconfirmed; none is scripted to spy on the Babloo encounter.
